name: Kolar Gold Fields experiments collaboration
notes: Authors of the 2000 paper: H. Adarkar, S. R. Dugad, M. R. Krishnaswamy, M. G. K. Menon, B. V. Sreekantan (Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, Bombay) and Y. Hayashi, N. Ito, S. Kawakami, S. Miyake, Y. Uchihori (Osaka City University). The 1965 neutrino work was by the 'Tata-Osaka-Durham group'. No official roster or institution count was found.

summary.plain: The Indian and Japanese physicists of the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research and Osaka City University who ran the underground experiments at Kolar Gold Fields.
summary.technical: TIFR (Bombay) and Osaka City University groups operating the KGF underground experiments, with Durham in the 1960s neutrino work.
